scripts.copy-web: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path www)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory www | Out-Null }; Copy-Item *.html www\ -Force; if (!(Test-Path www\js)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory www\js | Out-Null }; Copy-Item js\* www\js\ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Web files copied to www/'"
